question: How can I get the Lasher card for free, and when does the event end?

candidates.title: Labour Fest Gifts
candidates.text:
Hello, Commanders!

May Day is here, and with it comes warmer days - and free gifts. From Thursday, April 30 through Tuesday, May 5, a new free gift will be available to claim each day from the in-game Shop.

Each reward can only be claimed on its designated day - once it rotates out, it's gone for good. New gifts become available at 11:00 UTC daily and can be claimed for 24 hours, so make sure you log in every day to collect them all.

Alongside the free gifts, we also have a fresh selection of Shop offers to browse - including brand new cosmetic items. Keep an eye out for select Lottery Drops during the period, each lasting 48 hours: spend the minimum and take your shot at a random cosmetic reward. Don't miss the chance to grab great bundles at a fantastic value!
